bed_bunk_ladder.name: Bunk ladder
bed_bunk_ladder.flavor: Five rungs between you and the top bunk's sense of superiority.

bed_dressing_screen.name: Dressing screen
bed_dressing_screen.flavor: For changing behind, or for hiding the ironing.

bed_quilt_rack.name: Quilt rack
bed_quilt_rack.flavor: Displays the good quilt. The good quilt is not for using.

bed_valet_stand.name: Valet stand
bed_valet_stand.flavor: Holds tomorrow's suit with more patience than you.

bed_trouser_press.name: Trouser press
bed_trouser_press.flavor: A creased trouser is a statement. This is the counter-argument.

bed_ironing_board.name: Ironing board
bed_ironing_board.flavor: Comes out for interviews and funerals.

bed_clothes_airer.name: Clothes airer
bed_clothes_airer.flavor: Indoor drying season runs September to June.

bed_end_bench.name: End-of-bed bench
bed_end_bench.flavor: For clothes that are not clean, not dirty, and not going anywhere.

bed_headboard.name: Spare headboard
bed_headboard.flavor: From a bed that left in a previous move. Optimistic.

bed_rolled_futon.name: Rolled futon
bed_rolled_futon.flavor: A guest bed, provided the guest is flexible.

bed_moses_basket.name: Moses basket on a stand
bed_moses_basket.flavor: Outgrown in eleven weeks. Kept for eleven years.

bed_changing_table.name: Changing table
bed_changing_table.flavor: The busiest surface in the house for about two years.

bed_baby_walker.name: Baby walker
bed_baby_walker.flavor: Top speed one skirting board per minute.

bed_childs_table.name: Child's table and stools
bed_childs_table.flavor: Everything at knee height, including the arguments.

bed_play_tent.name: Play tent
bed_play_tent.flavor: Admission by password. The password changes hourly.

bed_ladder_shelf.name: Ladder shelf
bed_ladder_shelf.flavor: Leans against the wall like it pays rent.

bed_cube_storage.name: Cube storage unit
bed_cube_storage.flavor: Four cubes, four systems, no system.

bed_underbed_drawer.name: Under-bed drawer
bed_underbed_drawer.flavor: Home of the summer duvet and one lost sock a year.

bed_upright_vacuum.name: Upright vacuum
bed_upright_vacuum.flavor: Picks up everything except the mood.

bed_dehumidifier.name: Dehumidifier
bed_dehumidifier.flavor: Fills a bucket a day. Nobody admits where from.

bed_washstand.name: Washstand with jug and bowl
bed_washstand.flavor: From before taps. Still waiting for them.

bed_toy_kitchen.name: Toy kitchen
bed_toy_kitchen.flavor: Serves plastic croissants with total commitment.

bed_hobby_horse.name: Hobby horse
bed_hobby_horse.flavor: Goes anywhere, eats nothing, refuses every fence.

bed_chamber_pot.name: Chamber pot
bed_chamber_pot.flavor: From the house's pre-plumbing years. Now holds pot-pourri, officially.

bed_breakfast_tray.name: Breakfast-in-bed tray
bed_breakfast_tray.flavor: Crumbs in the bed are the price of luxury.

bed_reading_pillow.name: Reading pillow
bed_reading_pillow.flavor: Turns a bed into an armchair and a book into a nap.

bed_hot_water_bottle.name: Hot water bottle
bed_hot_water_bottle.flavor: Better company than most at two in the morning.

bed_lava_lamp.name: Lava lamp
bed_lava_lamp.flavor: Has been warming up since about 1974.

bed_music_box.name: Music box
bed_music_box.flavor: Plays half a waltz, then thinks better of it.

bed_piggy_bank.name: Piggy bank
bed_piggy_bank.flavor: Currently holding two buttons and a promise.

bed_perfume_tray.name: Perfume tray
bed_perfume_tray.flavor: Each bottle a different decade of good intentions.

bed_vanity_case.name: Vanity case
bed_vanity_case.flavor: Packed for a weekend in 1968 and never quite unpacked.

bed_watch_winder.name: Watch winder
bed_watch_winder.flavor: Keeps a watch running for someone who never wears it.

bed_headphone_stand.name: Headphone stand
bed_headphone_stand.flavor: Displays the headphones that cost more than the speakers.

bed_stacking_rings.name: Stacking rings
bed_stacking_rings.flavor: Teaches order. The order is mostly ignored.

bed_block_tub.name: Tub of building bricks
bed_block_tub.flavor: Eleven hundred bricks, all in the instructions-optional range.

bed_xylophone.name: Toy xylophone
bed_xylophone.flavor: Knows one tune and plays it relentlessly.

bed_spinning_top.name: Spinning top
bed_spinning_top.flavor: Hums when it spins. Sulks when it stops.

bed_pull_along_dog.name: Pull-along dog
bed_pull_along_dog.flavor: Follows obediently, unlike the real thing.

bed_baby_monitor.name: Baby monitor
bed_baby_monitor.flavor: Broadcasts snoring to the next room in high fidelity.

bed_nappy_caddy.name: Nappy caddy
bed_nappy_caddy.flavor: Organised in a way that survives no actual emergency.

bed_tissue_box.name: Box of tissues
bed_tissue_box.flavor: Every cold in the household, catalogued.

bed_bedside_carafe.name: Bedside carafe
bed_bedside_carafe.flavor: Holds stale water and the moral high ground.

bed_roller_tin.name: Tin of hair rollers
bed_roller_tin.flavor: Overnight curls at the cost of overnight sleep.

bed_lock_diary.name: Diary with a lock
bed_lock_diary.flavor: The lock is decorative. The secrets are not.

bed_star_projector.name: Star projector
bed_star_projector.flavor: Puts the night sky on the ceiling, with fewer clouds.

bed_pyjama_case.name: Pyjama case
bed_pyjama_case.flavor: Guards the pyjamas with a face of total devotion.

bed_wig_stand.name: Wig stand
bed_wig_stand.flavor: Wears the hats nobody else will.

bed_humidifier.name: Humidifier
bed_humidifier.flavor: Adds moisture to the air and a puddle to the shelf.

bed_nursery_mobile.name: Nursery mobile
bed_nursery_mobile.flavor: Turns gently above a baby who would rather be held.

bed_bed_warmer.name: Warming pan
bed_bed_warmer.flavor: Hot coals in the bed. The Victorians had nerve.

bed_tie_rack.name: Tie rack
bed_tie_rack.flavor: Seven ties. The one in the middle does all the work.

bed_dream_catcher.name: Dream catcher
bed_dream_catcher.flavor: Catches dreams. Releases them by about eleven.

bed_curtain_pole.name: Curtain pole and curtains
bed_curtain_pole.flavor: Closes about ninety per cent of the way. The rest is morning.

bed_picture_ledge.name: Picture ledge
bed_picture_ledge.flavor: For the photos you love and the one you are obliged to display.

bed_bunting.name: Bunting
bed_bunting.flavor: Left up after a birthday and promoted to decor.

bed_height_chart.name: Height chart
bed_height_chart.flavor: Pencil marks of everyone who stood still long enough.

bed_dressing_gown.name: Dressing gown on a hook
bed_dressing_gown.flavor: Worn twenty minutes a day, hung up for the rest.

bed_peg_rail.name: Peg rail
bed_peg_rail.flavor: Shaker discipline, overruled by a tote bag.

bed_mosquito_net.name: Mosquito net canopy
bed_mosquito_net.flavor: Keeps out the midges and lets in a sense of adventure.

bed_suit_carrier.name: Suit carrier
bed_suit_carrier.flavor: Protects the wedding suit through a wedding-free decade.

bed_medal_hanger.name: Medal hanger
bed_medal_hanger.flavor: Five parkruns and a fun run that wasn't.
